identificationModule.briefTitle: Efficacy and Safety of Fruquintinib With Sintilimab as First-line Therapy in Gastric Cancer
identificationModule.officialTitle: Clinical Study of Fruquintinib in Combination With Sintilimab as a First-line Therapy in Gastric Adenocarcinoma/Adenocarcinoma of Esophagogastric Junction

descriptionModule.briefSummary:
The goal of this clinical trial is to explore the efficacy and safety in patients with gastric adenocarcinoma or adenocarcinoma of esophagogastric junction. The main questions it aims to answer are:

* Does this therapy have a promising efficacy?
* Does this therapy have a manageable toxicity? Participants will receive fruquintinib plus sintilimab as first-line therapy for gastric cancer.

armGroups.label: Fruquintinib+Sintilimab
armGroups.description:
Fruquintinib: 5mg po, d1-d14, q3w

Sintilimab: 200mg ivgtt, d1, q3w

primaryOutcomes.description: The proportion of patients with complete response or partial response, using RECIST v 1.1.

secondaryOutcomes.description: Time from enrollment to the first documented disease progression or death due to any cause, whichever occurs first. Responses are according to the Response Evaluation Criteria in Solid Tumors version 1.1 (RECIST 1.1) as assessed by investigator
Time from randomization to death from any cause.
The proportion of patients with complete response, partial response or stable disease, using RECIST v 1.1.
Adverse event assessed according to CTCAE v5.0.
